# Vendored Proto annotations

`google/api/annotations.proto` and `google/api/http.proto` were copied read-only
from the verified local kitarbor reference during this migration. Their Google
copyright and Apache-2.0 headers are preserved. They provide google.api.http
annotations; Proto compiler includes provide descriptor/empty definitions.
The repository's Apache-2.0 license also applies to Authova-authored code.
